adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, the loop does `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` for each `rss.items` entry. If `i.content` is `nil` (e.g., feeds that only provide `description`), calling `.scrub` will raise `NoMethodError`, aborting the entire `rss.items.each` loop and preventing subsequent items from importing. There is no per-item rescue/handling in the job, and `sidekiq_options retry: false` means failures won’t be retried automatically, so the import can repeatedly fail on each hourly run.
